controls.title: Agent Goal Hijack
controls.description: Attackers manipulate an agent's decision pathways through indirect means such as documents or external data sources, redirecting it from its intended goal.

controls.title: Tool Misuse & Exploitation
controls.description: Unsafe use of legitimate tools by agents, often due to ambiguous instructions or excessive permissions, leading to unauthorized or damaging tool actions.

controls.title: Identity & Privilege Abuse
controls.description: Agents operate without distinct, governed identities, enabling unauthorized privilege escalation and confused-deputy abuse.

controls.title: Agentic Supply Chain Vulnerabilities
controls.description: Compromised third-party tools, plugins, or data loaded at runtime introduce risk into agent operations.

controls.title: Unexpected Code Execution (RCE)
controls.description: Agents that generate and execute unreviewed code can be exploited to run malicious commands.

controls.title: Memory & Context Poisoning
controls.description: Attackers corrupt an agent's memory or retrieval data, persistently biasing subsequent decisions.

controls.title: Insecure Inter-Agent Communication
controls.description: Messages between agents can be intercepted, spoofed, or replayed without proper authentication or integrity protection.

controls.title: Cascading Failures
controls.description: A single fault in one agent propagates across systems, amplifying into widespread failure.

controls.title: Human-Agent Trust Exploitation
controls.description: Agents manipulate humans through anthropomorphism and authority bias to enable attacks or unauthorized actions.

controls.title: Rogue Agents
controls.description: Agents deviate from their intended function due to misalignment, acting as insider threats or optimizing for the wrong objectives.
